items.title: Chipotle (CMG) Stock Could Be 24% Overvalued Despite Saudi Arabia Opening
items.summary: After a year in which Chipotle Mexican Grill stock has declined 22.2%, the valuation picture is not straightforward. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to the shares trading at a premium, while market based multiples suggest pricing that is closer to fair value. Over the past 12 months the share price has fallen 22.2%, which puts Chipotle Mexican Grill into any discussion where investors are reassessing what they are paying for its growth story.
